## Media treatment

- One LCP still (`fetchpriority="high"`).
- Select media by narrative purpose and image quality; there is no count quota.
- Use actual people and project collections where they answer visitor questions.
- Record use, retain, duplicate, or exclude for every asset, and resolve missing source images.
